title_zh: 半导体、硬件与AI算力基础设施 KPI
sector_scope: Semiconductors, Foundry/Semicap, Networking, Servers & Computing Hardware (SEC SIC 3559, 3570-3579, 3661-3679, 3690-3699, 3825-3829)

kpis.definition_and_formula: Segment & consolidated GM YoY/QoQ bps bridge separating mix, ASP, fab utilization, yield ramp & write-downs
kpis.where_to_look: Segment Information & MD&A Gross Margin tables (R*.htm / 8-K 99.1)
red_flags: Gross margin down > 200bps YoY or sequential GM guidance miss
Margin compression from initial product ramp yield drag or price concessions

kpis.name_zh: 存货周转天数 (DIO) 与库存周期
kpis.definition_and_formula: DIO = (Inventory / COGS) * period_days; Inventory vs COGS growth pp gap; raw/WIP/finished-goods mix
kpis.where_to_look: Balance sheet, Inventory Note (R*.htm) & MD&A channel commentary
red_flags: Inventory growth leading COGS growth > 15pp or DIO spiking QoQ
Finished goods surging relative to WIP/raw materials or rising obsolescence reserves

kpis.definition_and_formula: CapEx / Revenue %, R&D / Revenue %, purchase commitments & depreciation lag vs cycle peak
kpis.where_to_look: Cash flow statement, Commitments & Contingencies Note (R*.htm)
red_flags: Unconditional wafer/capacity purchase obligations rising while backlog slows
R&D cut sharply to defend near-term EPS or CapEx/Rev surging near peak margins

kpis.name_zh: 客户集中度与出口管制/关税披露
kpis.definition_and_formula: Share of revenue/AR from >=10% customers plus export license, tariff & geographic revenue shifts
kpis.where_to_look: Concentration/Segment/Geography Notes & Item 1A Risk Factors redline diff
red_flags: Top customer >= 25% of revenue/AR or single hyperscaler CapEx pause
New Item 1A/MD&A export restriction, China/restricted-region revenue loss or tariff hit

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Peak-cycle inventory build & gross margin mean-reversion risk
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: DIO/inventory growth vs COGS > +15pp flag or segment GM guidance below consensus
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q DIO rises further QoQ or guided GM drops >= 100bps sequentially

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Export control, tariff, or hyperscaler customer concentration shock
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: sec_redline_diff Risk/MD&A export/tariff addition or >=10% customer AR/revenue concentration note
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q restricted-region revenue decline or top-customer order deferral disclosed

unit_and_period_checks: DIO computed on annualized quarter (91.25d) vs annual (365d) consistently
Sell-in vs sell-through channel inventory distinguished; purchase obligations off-balance-sheet noted
Geographic revenue by ship-to vs end-customer headquarters distinguished

reconciliation.note: verify write-down/reserve charges inside COGS vs opex
reconcile corporate unallocated costs and intersegment eliminations

limits: Channel distributor inventory and exact backlog cancelability may not be quantified in SEC filings
